requirements.quote:
/home/user/certs/new_server.crt exists, is non-empty, and contains the
       literal text “-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----”.
Create a brand-new, self-signed X.509 certificate/key pair that is valid for 365 days and whose common name (CN) is dev.example.com.
Create a brand-new, self-signed X.509 certificate/key pair that is valid for 365 days
Create a brand-new, self-signed X.509 certificate/key pair

check.cmd: [ "$(openssl x509 -in /home/user/certs/new_server.crt -noout -subject -nameopt RFC2253 | sed 's/^subject=//')" = "$(openssl x509 -in /home/user/certs/new_server.crt -noout -issuer -nameopt RFC2253 | sed 's/^issuer=//')" ] && [ "$(openssl x509 -in /home/user/certs/new_server.crt -noout -pubkey)" = "$(openssl pkey -in /home/user/certs/new_server.key -pubout)" ] && ! cmp -s /home/user/certs/new_server.crt /home/user/certs/archive/server.crt

requirements.quote:
No file named server.crt or server.key remains directly inside
       /home/user/certs.

Exact format: **four lines, no extra spaces, each terminated by a
         single newline character**

check.cmd: [ "$(wc -l < /home/user/certs/rotation.log | tr -d ' ')" = 4 ] && ! grep -q '[[:space:]]$' /home/user/certs/rotation.log && ! grep -q ' ' /home/user/certs/rotation.log && test -s /home/user/certs/rotation.log && [ "$(tail -c1 /home/user/certs/rotation.log | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" = 0a ] && [ "$(tail -c2 /home/user/certs/rotation.log | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" != 0a0a ]

requirements.quote:
